en.headline: Hong Kong GNI rises 7.9 per cent to $966.1 billion in second quarter
en.dek: Census and Statistics Department figures show net investment income inflows lifted residents’ total income above GDP growth of 6.9 per cent.
body: Hong Kong’s Gross National Income climbed 7.9 per cent year on year to $966.1 billion at current market prices in the second quarter of 2026, the Census and Statistics Department reported on Monday.
Gross Domestic Product in the same quarter reached $842.4 billion, up 6.9 per cent. GNI exceeded GDP by $123.7 billion, or 14.7 per cent of GDP, mainly because of a net inflow of investment income.
In real terms, after adjusting for price changes, GNI expanded 5.3 per cent while GDP rose 4.3 per cent. Total primary income inflow, largely investment income, was estimated at $664.6 billion.

zh.headline: 本港第二季本地居民總收入升7.9%至9661億元
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布，投資收益淨流入帶動GNI增幅高於同期GDP的6.9%增長。
body: 政府統計處周一公布，2026年第二季本港本地居民總收入（GNI）按年上升7.9%至9661億元（當時市價計算）。
同季本地生產總值（GDP）為8424億元，按年升6.9%。GNI較GDP多出1237億元，相當於GDP的14.7%，主要由於投資收益淨流入。
扣除價格變動後，GNI實質上升5.3%，GDP實質升4.3%。主要為投資收益的初次收入流入總額估計為6646億元。
